title: A difference in standardized units
hook: Two stated cases: explore the spread behind a standardized effect.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the spread behind a standardized effect affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines D, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the spread behind a standardized effect in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
